Tomorrow, we’re entering a haunted TypeScript project. 🎃👻

There will be:

🧟 `unknown` zombies
🎃 gigantic object pumpkins
🕷️ suspicious gifts
🧛 Count Any

And somehow, they all teach us something about Type Guards. 😹

The funny part?

`unknown` isn’t actually the monster.

Unchecked `any` is. 💀

Halloween TypeScript adventure coming tomorrow! 😸
